summary.text: Jared Ploger is the Democratic nominee for Illinois State Senate District 42 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Edgardo Perez. A teacher in the Valley View School District 365U, he is a former member of the Oswego school board.
The Illinois Democratic Party chose him as nominee to replace Linda Holmes, who withdrew after winning the March 2026 primary.

paragraphs.text: Ploger earned a high school diploma from Somonauk High School, a bachelor's degree from Northern Illinois University, and a graduate degree from Olivet Nazarene University.
He has coached basketball and received the Coach of the Year award from the Illinois Basketball Coaches Association.
Ploger was an at-large member of the Oswego Community Unit School District 308 school board, assuming office in 2015.
He ran for the Democratic nomination for Illinois House District 84 in 2026 and lost the March 17 primary to Saba Haider, 63.5 percent to 36.5 percent.
